messages:
maria.chen: heads up, I'm about to apply a terraform change that switches the inference svc in cluster-a from ClusterIP->NodePort so NLB passthrough can map to host ports. quick check: healthcheck/readiness ports and targetPort mapping need to be explicit or we'll break k8s probe routing. any objections?

aj: quick question — why NodePort instead of keeping ClusterIP with targetGroup IP mode? are we routing via host networking on nodes for perf?

maria.chen: we need NLB TLS passthrough (SNI) for inference workloads; current gateway requires node port for sticky host-routing + client IP preservation. also some nodes are on older AMIs that only support the host port mapping we need.

dmitri: FYI when you change Service.type you also need to ensure `externalTrafficPolicy: Local` if we want source IP preserved — otherwise NLB will SNAT and probes may fail.

jen_sre: +1 on `externalTrafficPolicy: Local`. Also check readinessProbe.port vs containerPort vs service.targetPort mismatch. Common failure: probe hits container port but k8s routes to nodeport and healthcheck on NLB expects nodePort/instance-port.

maria.chen: copying the k8s svc snippet I'm planning to apply:```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: inference-gateway
  annotations:
    service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-type: "nlb"
    service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-backend-protocol: "tcp"
spec:
  type: NodePort
  externalTrafficPolicy: Local
  ports:
    - name: tls
      port: 443
      targetPort: 8080
      nodePort: 32443
  selector:
    app: inference-gw
```

aj: looks fine. One gotcha: ensure the healthcheck on the AWS target group is set to TCP on the nodePort (32443) not HTTP on 8080. If it's HTTP it will break TLS passthrough probes.

maria.chen: good call. Terraform change for the service resource will look like:```hcl
resource "kubernetes_service" "inference_gw" {
  metadata { name = "inference-gateway" }
  spec {
    type = "NodePort"
    external_traffic_policy = "Local"
    port { port = 443 target_port = 8080 node_port = 32443 }
  }
}
```

dmitri: also double-check the gateway/gateway-api config: if you're binding TLS certs at the ALB/ingress layer for control plane, make sure we aren't accidentally terminating TLS for inference routes. We want passthrough to the node port.

jen_sre: For Terraform apply order: create NodePort svc before attaching target group/target registration, otherwise target group will have no healthy targets. Maybe add a small pause or use `depends_on` on the service resource in the target registration module.

deploy-bot: Deploy plan queued for review by @aj and @dmitri — plan shows change: Service(inference-gateway) type: ClusterIP -> NodePort, nodePort: 32443.

aj: I will review the plan. also please add a note in the PR about the AWS side healthcheck mode (TCP) and that `externalTrafficPolicy` is Local — makes rollbacks clearer.

maria.chen: thanks — I'll update the PR with healthcheck change and `depends_on` for target registration. Will apply after approvals. :thumbsup:

jen_sre: one last reminder: add metrics alert for 5xx spike on inference-gw during rollout window, and we can do a canary by applying to cluster-b first (low-traffic).

maria.chen: noted, will canary on cluster-b first and add alerts. thanks everyone!
